name: MMAU
intro: MMAU 是一个大规模多任务音频理解与推理 benchmark，用于评估音频语言模型在语音、环境声和音乐上的高级感知、信息抽取和复杂推理能力。它包含约 1 万个精心筛选的音频片段，并配有人类标注的自然语言问答，覆盖 27 项技能。
build_method: 人工标注, 专家筛选, 混合构建
task_type: 音频理解, 音频推理
eval_feature: 音频推理, 信息抽取, 27项技能, 领域知识
eval_feature_en: Audio reasoning, Information extraction, 27 skills, Domain knowledge
intro_en: MMAU is a massive multi-task audio understanding and reasoning benchmark for evaluating audio-language models on advanced perception, information extraction, and complex reasoning over speech, environmental sounds, and music. It contains about 10k curated audio clips paired with human-annotated natural-language questions and answers across 27 skills.
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Collect audio from speech, environmental sound, and music sources"] --> B["Curate a diverse pool of 10k audio clips for multimodal audio understanding"]
    B --> C["Pair clips with human-annotated natural-language questions and answers"]
    C --> D["Separate information-extraction items from complex reasoning items"]
    D --> E["Map questions to 27 distinct audio understanding and reasoning skills"]
    E --> F["Apply quality checks to keep expert-level, domain-specific tasks"]
    F --> G["Evaluate open-source and proprietary audio-language models"]
    G --> H["Report accuracy and skill-level weaknesses for advanced audio reasoning"]

    B --> C["为音频片段配对人工标注的自然语言问题和答案"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2410.19168, the MMAU homepage, and the official GitHub repository. MMAU comprises 10k carefully curated audio clips paired with human-annotated natural-language QA across speech, environmental sounds, and music. The paper emphasizes information extraction and reasoning questions, 27 distinct skills, expert-level/domain-specific knowledge, evaluation of 18 open-source and proprietary audio-language models, and accuracy reporting.
